name: Southern Cable Group Berhad
overview: 2026年公司没有发布涉及业务板块扩张、新增业务、缩减或出售的公告，所披露的公告主要为季度业绩、股息除权、股份分拆/附加上市及集资相关事项。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长25.8%，净利润同比增长28.2%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any business segment expansion, new business, reduction, or divestment; its announcements mainly covered quarterly results, dividend ex-dates, share subdivision/additional listing, and fund-raising matters. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue grew 25.8% year-on-year and net profit grew 28.2% year-on-year.
